facts.text: Under its All-Grant financial aid program, Williams eliminates all student loans and work-study requirements from financial aid packages, replacing them with institutional grants that do not need to be repaid.

sources.title: Types of Aid and Financing - Williams College
sources.quote: Through our All-Grant financial aid program, Williams eliminated loans and work-study requirements from our financial aid packages. Instead, the college offers grants that do not have to be repaid.

facts.text: Williams provides a Book Grant that covers the full cost of all required textbooks and course materials for every student receiving financial aid.

sources.title: Types of Aid and Financing - Williams College
sources.quote: Williams is famous for our Book Grant, which covers the full cost of all required textbooks and course materials for every aided student.
